item.title: Cahill Elects Five New Partners And Promotes Two Attorneys To Counsel
item.description: Cahill Gordon & Reindel LLP said it has elected five attorneys to its partnership and promoted two attorneys to counsel, with all changes effective January 1, 2026. The post Cahill Elects Five New Partners And Promotes Two Attorneys To Counsel appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: Stord Acquires Shipwire From CEVA Logistics To Expand Fulfillment Network and AI Capabilities
item.description: Stord announced it has closed its acquisition of Shipwire, a subsidiary of CEVA Logistics, in a deal that will expand its fulfillment footprint, deepen its software capabilities, and strengthen its relationship with one of the world’s largest logistics providers. Stord said the transaction closed Jan. 1. The post Stord Acquires Shipwire From CEVA Logistics To Expand Fulfillment Network and AI Capabilities appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: The Tie Acquires Stakin, Launching Infrastructure Solutions Division for Institutional Staking
item.description: The Tie, an institutional digital asset solutions provider, said it has acquired Stakin, a staking provider with $1.5 billion in assets under delegation, in a deal that expands The Tie’s platform into digital asset infrastructure and establishes a new Infrastructure Solutions business line. item.title: Cox Castle Names Scott Laes And Jamie Sprague Partners
item.description: Cox, Castle & Nicholson announced it has elected litigation attorneys Scott Laes and Jamie Sprague to the firm’s partnership, effective January 1, 2026, as the real estate-focused law firm expands senior leadership within its disputes practice. item.title: Carlyle To Sell Electron Microscope Maker Tescan To Shimadzu In $850 Million Deal
item.description: Global investment firm Carlyle announced it has agreed to sell Tescan Group, a manufacturer of electron microscopes and advanced scientific and analytical instruments, to Shimadzu Corporation, a Japan-based provider of analytical and measuring technologies. The transaction values Tescan at an enterprise value of $850 million. The post Carlyle To Sell Electron Microscope Maker Tescan To Shimadzu In $850 Million Deal appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: MidEuropa To Buy Majority Stake In Romanian Business Consult
item.description: MidEuropa announced it has agreed to acquire a majority stake in Romanian Business Consult (RBC), a Romania-based IT system integrator focused on the retail, banking, and industrials sectors. Founder and CEO Andrei Bojiță will retain a significant minority stake and continue to lead the business, according to the announcement. item.description: Microsoft announced it has acquired Osmos, an agentic AI data engineering platform designed to simplify complex data preparation workflows and help organizations turn raw data into analytics- and AI-ready assets within OneLake, the unified data lake at the core of Microsoft Fabric. item.title: PNC Completes Acquisition Of FirstBank, Expanding Footprint in Colorado And Arizona
item.description: The PNC Financial Services Group announced it has completed its acquisition of FirstBank Holding Company and its banking subsidiary, FirstBank, after receiving all required regulatory approvals and satisfying customary closing conditions. The transaction expands PNC’s presence in Colorado and Arizona, which the bank described as high-growth markets aligned with its broader expansion strategy.
